scope: Targeted Phase 5 extraction from the official Planeswalker's Guide to Aetherdrift (parts 1-2, 2024-12-10/11) and Aetherdrift Magic Story episodes and side stories (2025-01-13 to 2025-01-20). PRELIMINARY_RESEARCH; not owner approved.

claims.subject: champions_of_amonkhet

quotes.quote: Zahur, Basri, and the rest of the Amonkheti take to the stage bedecked in gold and bright linen.
When they receive the Aetherspark, it is as a team—no one person's hand touches it before any other.

claims.summary: The Amonkheti team receives the Aetherspark as a team at the end of the Grand Prix.

claims.subject: zahur

quotes.quote: Zahur leads the Amonkheti delegation alongside Basri Ket and a crew of living and undead charioteers.

claims.summary: Zahur leads the Amonkheti team, with Basri Ket.

claims.subject: chandra_nalaar

quotes.quote: Cloudspire's co-captains are Chandra Nalaar and Kolodin, the latter being last year's sole captain.

claims.summary: Chandra Nalaar co-captains Cloudspire with Kolodin.

claims.subject: chandra_nalaar

quotes.quote: However, Chandra's desire to win the Aetherspark for her lover, Nissa, overrode other loyalties.
Just as she opens her mouth to begin, Nissa kisses her.

claims.summary: Chandra races to win the Aetherspark for her lover Nissa.

claims.subject: pia_nalaar

quotes.quote: She picks up another samosa, following Pia as the former renegade leads her daughter to the dining room.
Chandra's choice to join Cloudspire over the Aether Rangers sent shockwaves through the Avishkari public, who assumed she would join her mother as co-captain of the home team.

claims.summary: Pia Nalaar is Chandra's mother.

claims.subject: valgavoth

quotes.quote: Winter is a survivor of Duskmourn who has been granted temporary leave by Valgavoth, the archdemon of the plane, to try and win the Aetherspark for reasons, of course, of Valgavoth's own.

claims.summary: Valgavoth lets Winter leave Duskmourn temporarily to try to win the Aetherspark for him.
claims.limitation: The guide says his freedom depends on winning; this links to Valgavoth seizing Winter in DSK.

claims.subject: winter

quotes.quote: Winter and the Speed Demon hold Loot captive and plan to take advantage of his abilities in the race.

claims.summary: Winter and the Speed Demon hold Loot captive.

claims.subject: winter

quotes.quote: Bring us the Aetherspark, and you're free.
If Winter (or a racer on his crew) wins, he might be granted his freedom.

claims.summary: Winter races for the Aetherspark to win his freedom.
claims.limitation: The episode line is dialogue addressed to Winter.

claims.subject: gonti

quotes.quote: Since the Phyrexian invasion and the collapse of the old Consulate in the Indigo Revolution, the Grand Prix has been championed by the new night minister of Ghirapur, Gonti.

claims.summary: Gonti, Ghirapur's night minister, champions and oversees the Grand Prix.
claims.limitation: 'Championed' and 'overseen' rather than run day to day.

claims.subject: mendicant_core

quotes.quote: The Guidelight Voyagers are an uncanny collection of automatons captained by a single mind

claims.summary: Mendicant Core captains the Guidelight Voyagers.

claims.subject: loot

quotes.quote: Loot, for his part, clings to Chandra's shoulders and wonders how exactly any of this came to happen.
As she sets off to start collecting tinder—dried palm leaves, shavings from the trees, what grasses she thinks might help—Loot bounds up onto her shoulders, chirping enthusiastically.

claims.summary: By episode 5, Loot travels with Chandra.

claims.subject: mahitab

quotes.quote: Mahitab found Niharet and freed her, but the girl Mahitab had grown up with, the girl she'd loved, was never the same again.

claims.summary: Mahitab freed Niharet after she was entombed.

claims.subject: pia_nalaar

quotes.quote: Pia Nalaar, the former popular leader of the Renegades

claims.summary: Pia Nalaar is the former popular leader of the Renegades, now a reform-minded consul.

claims.subject: kaladesh

quotes.quote: In this effort, Avishkar has come to recognize Ravnica as its chief rival.
Avishkar is the new name for the plane formerly known as Kaladesh

claims.summary: Avishkar (the renamed Kaladesh) sees Ravnica as its chief multiversal rival.
claims.limitation: Avishkar is modelled on the existing kaladesh plane node; the guide calls it a rival, 'not as an enemy (yet)'.

claims.subject: niv_mizzet

quotes.quote: Ravnica, along with its guilds and their leader, Niv-Mizzet

claims.summary: The guide names Niv-Mizzet as leader of Ravnica's guilds.

claims.subject: ketramose

quotes.quote: two new, risen deities that walk alongside Hazoret on Amonkhet: Ketramose, the lion of dawn

claims.summary: Ketramose is one of two new risen deities on Amonkhet.

claims.subject: sab_sunen

quotes.quote: and Sab-Sunen, the new mother of the Luxa

claims.summary: Sab-Sunen is the other new risen deity on Amonkhet, alongside Hazoret.

claims.subject: basri_ket

quotes.quote: Basri watches an older member of the Champions throw himself before a wicked slice meant for Zahur.
Without waiting for further banter—they cannot afford the time—Basri clambers atop the chariot.

claims.summary: Basri rides with Zahur and the Champions of Amonkhet in the race.
claims.limitation: Episode 3 shows Basri riding with the Champions; the explicit delegation wording is in Part 1 of the guide.

claims.subject: pia_nalaar

quotes.quote: she spots Pia Nalaar sitting with the Amonkheti team

claims.summary: Spitfire sees Pia Nalaar sitting with the Amonkheti team.
claims.limitation: Sitting with the team is the only evidence on this page; 'allied_with' is an editorial reading.

claims.subject: mohar_varma

quotes.quote: Mohar says. He takes a seat across from his old friend.

claims.summary: Consul Mohar Varma visits his old friend Rudra in Ghirapur's underground.

claims.subject: khal

quotes.quote: Ultimately, however, son of Telu as he was, Khrad was first the son of Khal.
King Khal hesitated; a warrior himself since he could clutch a blade, he knew what threats his only son would face.

claims.summary: Khrad is the only son of King Khal, who fears for him on his quest.

claims.subject: khal

quotes.quote: King Khal, ruler of the Telu-Set, listened stony-faced.

claims.summary: King Khal rules the Telu-Set.

claims.subject: amarth_tel

quotes.quote: Ley mage of the Tarry Spire, supreme among Mon'Telu's foes!

claims.summary: The ley mage Amarth-Tel is the foremost enemy of Mon'Telu, stronghold of the Telu-Set.

claims.subject: telu_set

quotes.quote: Everywhere in Muraganda, life burst forth unceasing.
in Mon'Telu, central stronghold of the Telu-Set

claims.summary: The Telu-Set's stronghold Mon'Telu lies on Muraganda.
claims.limitation: The story is set on Muraganda; Mon'Telu's location is inferred from the setting.

remaining: Episodes 3 and 4, 'Like No Other Beast' and guide part 2 are not cited
The unnamed 'man in blue' on Tarkir in the final scene is not identified
Sita/Spitfire, her father's coup attempt and Elspeth's role in stopping it are not graded
